entries.title: Estimating Population Mean Power Under Conditions of Heterogeneity and Selection for Significance
entries.version_evidence: Meta-Psychology's public OSF node peumw separates files into 1. Submission and 2. Review Round 1. The URLs identify 874-Manuscript in PDF-2177-1-2-20180425.pdf and Donald Williams' round-1 review respectively. The review quotes phrases present in that submitted manuscript, including 'two populations of power'.
entries.verified_note: The review is DOCX and the manuscript is PDF. Hashes were calculated from OSF downloads on 2026-09-07. This methods-heavy pair is a technical smoke case, not representative validation of empirical psychology reviewing.
